name: Sonnet macro/sector rotation
strategy: Rotate into rate-sensitive small caps, industrial/capex reacceleration, and dollar-debasement hedges (gold, EM) funded by trimming exposure to the extended AI-infra trade, keeping a large cash buffer earning 4% given crypto bear/AI correction risk.

positions.thesis: Small caps lag large caps on cycle but are most levered to Fed rate cuts and lower financing costs; H1 catch-up (+19.4%) likely extends as easing continues.
Industrial capex reacceleration theme (reshoring, grid, factory build-out) benefits broad industrials beyond the narrow AI-infra trade.
Direct capex-cycle beneficiary with pricing power; construction/mining equipment demand tracks lower rates and infrastructure spend.
Long duration is cheap after a flat H1 (-1%); Fed easing into year-end should finally reward duration as the curve prices further cuts.
A weakening dollar trend and Fed easing typically lift EM/China equities via cheaper dollar funding and capital rotation out of crowded US AI names.
Gold's H1 pullback (-6.5%) sets up a rebound as real rates fall with Fed cuts and the dollar trend turns lower into H2.
3x semis already up 250% H1 and now correcting on AI-disruption/valuation fears; a modest short hedges against further momentum unwind in the most extended pocket of the market.

outlook: Fed easing cycle and a softening dollar favor small-caps, industrial capex, and EM/gold over the H2 back half, while the extended AI-infrastructure trade needs to digest its H1 gains; positioning tilts toward rate-sensitive breadth expansion with a modest hedge against renewed AI momentum unwind.
